title: In situ synchrotron CT fatigue of A357-T6 cast Al with controlled internal shrinkage pores (SLS TOMCAT)

chemistry.notes: From Methods of Serrano-Munoz et al. 2017

processing.parameters: Cast rods phi30 x 250 mm supplied by CTIF; SDAS 38 um; specimens EDM-cut around pores pre-located by lab CT (gauge 4 mm high, ~2x2 mm cross-section)
processing.heat_treatment: T6: solution 540 C/10 h, water quench, aged 160 C/8 h (peak age)
processing.surface_condition: ~300 um ground off after EDM, polished to 0.02 um

acquisition.facility: Swiss Light Source (PSI) TOMCAT beamline (in situ); lab Phoenix Vtome for pre-screening
acquisition.notes: Synchrotron: 25 keV monochromatic, 70 mm propagation distance, 1.7 um effective pixel. Lab CT screening: 90 kV, 240 uA, 4 um voxel; ~100 specimens screened, 20-25% suitable.

defects.statistics: Pore volume fraction 0.002% (bulk). Largest internal pore per specimen sqrt(area) 300-386 um; surface initiating pores sqrt(area) 80-154 um. SLS-14: Pore1 (surface) 120 um, Pore2 210 um, Pore3 340 um, Pore4 300 um.

fatigue.loading: Uniaxial tension-tension, R=0.1, 10 Hz, sigma_max 200-240 MPa (5 specimens)
fatigue.results: Nf / stopped at 73,000-355,000 cycles; internal crack growth slower than surface crack growth; CT-specimen da/dN vs Kmax in air and vacuum for reference
fatigue.crack_initiation: All specimens failed/were dominated by surface cracks from casting defects up to 10x smaller than internal pores; internal pores (sqrt(area) ~340-386 um) nucleated faceted internal cracks later. Initiation and growth tracked in 3D; FE on real pore geometry (yielded volume).

references.citation: Serrano-Munoz I., Buffiere J.-Y., Mokso R., Verdu C., Nadot Y., Location, location & size: defects close to surfaces dominate fatigue crack initiation, Scientific Reports 7 (2017) 45239

Serrano-Munoz I., Buffiere J.-Y., Verdu C., Gaillard Y., Mu P., Nadot Y., Influence of surface and internal casting defects on the fatigue behaviour of A357-T6 cast aluminium alloy, Int. J. Fatigue 82 (2016) 361-370

notes: Key benchmark for internal vs surface pore criticality in cast Al.

title: Torsional fatigue of A357-T6 cast Al: interrupted in situ synchrotron tomography of crack propagation

chemistry.notes: Composition not re-verified for this paper

processing.parameters: Coarse-grained cast A357 (grain size ~500 um)

acquisition.facility: ESRF ID19 (per Shiozawa et al. 2015 conference paper)
acquisition.notes: Interrupted in situ cyclic torsion; surface crack monitoring + EBSD for initiation
